Compare [Version A](http://maker:4001/search.html?mode=live&bulk=always) and [Version B](http://maker:4001/search.html?mode=live&bulk=mode).

In each, select **Making Sense of Color Palettes** and **A Calm Guide to Happy Houseplants**, then delete the selected bookmarks and confirm. The collection should drop from six bookmarks to four.

Which way of entering and making a multi-item selection feels safer and more natural?

I’ve assumed bulk deletion shows the number selected and uses a separate confirmation that explicitly says the removal is permanent and cannot be undone.

Captured results: `bulk-always-visible.png` and `bulk-select-mode.png`.
